title: God doesn’t hate people.
paragraphs:
God doesn’t hate people.
But there are things He refuses to tolerate.
You won’t hear this in soft sermons.
But Scripture doesn’t whisper—it warns.

Proverbs 6:16–19 lays it out raw.
Seven things. Not suggestions. Not preferences.
Things God hates.

1. A proud look
That silent elevation of self.
“I’m better.”
“I deserve more.”
Pride doesn’t shout—it sits on the throne of your heart.

2. A lying tongue
Not just big lies.
Half-truths.
Excuses.
Masks.
Every lie builds a life God cannot bless.

3. Hands that shed innocent blood
Violence.
Abuse.
Even hatred that simmers long enough to wish harm.
Jesus said anger can carry the seed of murder.

4. A heart that devises wicked plans
Sin doesn’t start in action.
It starts in imagination.
Schemes.
Hidden agendas.
Private darkness.

5. Feet that run to evil
Not stumbling—running.
Eager to sin.
Quick to click.
Fast to fall.

6. A false witness who pours out lies
Destroying others with words.
Twisting truth.
Killing reputations.
All while smiling.

7. A person who stirs up division
This one cuts deep.
God hates division among His people.
Gossip.
Drama.
Tearing down what He’s building.
That’s heavy.

And if we’re honest…
we’ve been on that list.

Not once.
Not twice.
But repeatedly.
But here’s what we miss…
God doesn’t reveal what He hates to push you away.
He reveals it to pull you back.

Because every one of those sins—
every lie, every prideful thought, every hidden scheme—
was nailed to the cross of Jesus Christ.

He took what God hates…
so you could receive what God loves.

Forgiveness.
Cleansing.
A new heart.
You don’t fix this list by trying harder.
You bring it to Jesus.

Repent.
Surrender.
Let grace do what effort never could.
Drop “Grace” if you’re choosing truth over pride today.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
